stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_next: One moment kept. Resume, try a maneuver, then use Study this moment to keep a second view. Match the camera angle for an easier comparison.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_full: Two moments kept. Describe what changed. Remove a moment when you are ready to try another comparison.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_no_image: Image unavailable. The simulation readings are saved.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_note: What do you notice in moment {letter}?
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_added: Moment and observation added to your field notebook.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_removed: Moment removed. Any copy in your notebook is kept.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_deltas: Airspeed: {speed} mph. Height above ground: {height} m.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_different: These moments come from different flights. Compare the features you can see; the readings are not a controlled trial.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_limits: Camera angle can change how a pose looks. Several flight conditions can change together, so a speed difference alone does not establish its cause.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_explain: Open your notebook to build an explanation. It keeps the original readings and the observation you added for each moment.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_write: Write an observation to add a moment to your notebook. Saved notebook copies remain unchanged when you edit or remove these moments.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_predict: To collect these moments as evidence, open the dive investigation and add your starting prediction in the notebook.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_session: Kept moments stay with this lab session. Notebook downloads include your words and the simulation readings.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_capacity: Two moments saved. Review them below the flight, or remove one to make room.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_resume_hin: Resume and try a change before keeping another moment.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_capture_hi: Keep this view and its readings to compare after your next maneuver.
stem.raptorhunt.study_compare_saved: Moment kept with simulation readings. Review kept moments below the flight.
